enumeration_note: One bidirectional Fibonacci-pullback continuation strategy; the buy and sell sides are directional mirrors of the same skeleton (trade with the trend into the 50–61.8% retracement), not opposing plays — enumerated as one strategy with long/short variants.

coaching_notes: You always need to enter the market in early stages of its trend otherwise you'll end up losing your trade
If you have identified the trend on its early stages then you can end up making huge profits from a single trend, because you just need to repeat the same process again and again
You don't need to wait longer for a trading signal in a trending market
There is a good risk to reward ratio in this method
But if you'll follow each step carefully then the chances of loss are minimal
element_inventory: PRECONDITION: identify trend direction on the 4H timeframe using a trend line before trading
PRECONDITION: only trade in a trending market (do not trade a non-trending market)
Use Fibonacci retracement indicator to define price-action levels
Buy only when the market is in an uptrend; sell only when in a downtrend
Draw Fibonacci from swing low to recent swing high (buy) / swing high to recent swing low (sell)
Entry trigger: price touches the 50% or 61.8% Fibonacci level; enter anywhere between the 50% and 61.8% levels
Buy TP: above the previous swing high; Buy SL: below the swing low
Sell TP: below the previous swing low; Sell SL: above the swing high
strategies.entry_summary: Trade with the trend: first identify trend direction on the 4H chart using a trend line, then on the 1H chart draw a Fibonacci retracement (swing low→recent swing high in an uptrend / swing high→recent swing low in a downtrend) and enter in the trend direction when price touches the 50%–61.8% zone (buy in uptrend, sell in downtrend).
strategies.exit_summary: Buy: take profit above the previous swing high, stop loss below the swing low. Sell: take profit below the previous swing low, stop loss above the swing high.
strategies.name: fibonacci_pullback_continuation

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Fibonacci drawn swing low to recent swing high; enter buy anywhere in the 50%–61.8% retracement zone; only when market is in uptrend
variants.target_note: TP above previous swing high; SL below swing low
variants.transcript_quote: draw the fibonacci from swing low to the recent swing high and wait for the price to touch the 50 or 61.8% line. And place your buy trade anywhere between these two levels.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Fibonacci drawn swing high to recent swing low; enter sell anywhere in the 50%–61.8% retracement zone; only when market is in downtrend
variants.target_note: TP below previous swing low; SL above swing high
variants.transcript_quote: draw the fibonacci from swing high to the recent swing low and wait for the price to touch the 50 or 61.8% line. And place your sell trade anywhere between these two levels.
